## Summary

What this pull request changes, and why. Link the related issue, if any.

## Testing

How you tested it, for example `npm test`, `npm run check:release`,
`claude plugin validate .`, or a manual render.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated where appropriate (README, SKILL.md, docs/, CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] The change stays within FeatureLens's scope (no unrelated features)
- [ ] Security and safety properties are preserved: no dependencies, no network access, CSP, path confinement, manual-section and history protection
- [ ] Backwards compatibility considered (manifest schema, CLI flags and exit codes, rendered output)
